gaps.sentence: A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.

gaps.sentence: These old boots are completely worn ___.
gaps.explanation: wear out = become thin/unusable through use.

gaps.sentence: The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.

gaps.sentence: Don't worry — he always turns ___ late.
gaps.explanation: turn up = arrive, often unexpectedly or late.

gaps.sentence: They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.
